notes.title: The Release
notes.content: [p]Only Cards is releasing right now![/p][p][/p][p]This is kind of a new experience for me, since I almost always did action/arcade games before. But now, I love tabletop games too. Someone may say that the game is too small and simple, but I enjoyed core mechanics of Only Cards very much. This is probably the most original game I ever made. And I hope you play and see this beauty in card mechanics, too.[/p][p][/p][p]This was a harsh year for adult games on Steam. But I'll continue to make games as long as I can. To everyone who participated in this project, or just played the demo, thank you![/p]

notes.title: September 4
notes.content: [p]Good news! The build has passed moderation. Only Cards will be released on September 4. Yes, the same date as for you-know-what. The game is ready, I'm just doing some final polishing and testing.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned! I hope to see you at the game's release.[/p]

notes.title: The release date will be announced soon
notes.content: [p]Hello, everyone! The game is almost ready, but the moderation process is unfortunately taking much longer than expected. This is not surprising, considering the recent situation with adult games on Steam.[/p][p]I hope to release the game at the beginning of September.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for following the game![/p]

notes.title: Steam Next demo
notes.content: [p]Only Cards is joining Steam Next Fest![/p][p][/p][p]Get ready to try the free demo and experience a unique blend of deck-building and puzzle mechanics with stylish anime visuals and a hint of spice.[/p][p]The demo contains the beginning of the story and five puzzle levels. The shop and bin are also available so you can try different cards and combinations.[/p][p][/p][p]Add Only Cards to your wishlist if you haven't already![/p]
